author_controls.runtime: Task-local venv Python3.15.0, PyYAML6.0.3 built from PyPI source distribution; not minimum-supported Python runtime validation.
author_controls.scope: Unchanged common.py and cleanup.py; temporary owned cards, no user vault. Positive preservation assertion and domain incompatibility observations; not four upstream failures.

findings: Same-stem/domain/type cards grouped despite different body bytes; native observed, intended card-candidate behavior not exact file identity.
Transitive identity bridge joins3cards although each key used by2cards and max_shared2. max_shared is per-key guard, not advertised component-size limit; no breach of that contract inferred.
NFC normalization coalesces explicit exact-index path keys; last supplied spelling wins. On macOS no claim both Unicode spellings are separate on-disk files.
Cleanup repaired repeated description and preserved NUL-containing body bytes in positive owned fixture. No concurrent mutation test in this increment.
FrontmatterLoader rejects duplicate/non-string YAML keys and merge keys; serializer re-parses fields to verify value preservation. Source read, broader YAML runtime tests not executed.
files=empty list falls back to vault walk via files or walk_vault, so caller cannot use [] to explicitly select zero files. Source-only.
infer_domain uses configured startswith patterns while raw_dirs validation enforces slash boundaries. Inference fallback choices not a file identity contract.
